name: Zoan mastery
description: Animal forms, hybrid and full: Endurance speeds the control.

stages.name: Changing without accidents
stages.text: You changed and changed back, on purpose, and nothing broke.

stages.name: Hybrid control
stages.description: Hold the form between human and beast.
stages.text: You held the half-beast form and kept your head.

stages.name: Full form
stages.text: You became the beast entirely, and it did not become you.

stages.name: Extra forms
stages.text: You found a form between the forms, one nobody had shown you.

stages.name: Stamina in forms
stages.description: Hold a form for a day of fighting.
stages.text: You fought a whole day in your beast's shape and were not spent.

stages.name: Awakening
stages.description: The beast's body heals and hits far past its nature, at the risk of rampage.
stages.text: Something old and wild woke in the beast's body: you had awakened.
